items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: Oliver made the tour with us

ctx.x: Sorry we didn't bring that picture here tonight. Yeah. But do you remember who else was in the band? Well yeah.

I was going to tell you, Harry Faglitude on a banjo, Warren Bennett playing alto, Lucen Johnson was playing alto, I was playing tenor. And later on Warren Lesbavis got Oliver Alcorn, because Oliver made the tour with us. And because Warren, just like I told you, Warren wanted to go back to Mississippi and put that roof on his house. So when I had Warren was very good and Oliver was good and Lucien Johnson, well after Warren left the band, Lucien Johnson was playing the clarinet solos. And I was playing tenor and…

By the way, one time there was a little brother Montgomery, he came from Mississippi. Did he ever bring him? We picked him up in Jackson, Mississippi. Well he played with us. He played with your son of Montgomery. He played with us at the same time. He made it too with us.
